overlay.exampletoast.spirit.title: Double Ninth Clouds · Reaching Higher
overlay.exampletoast.spirit.line1: On the Double Ninth Festival, may your heart rise above the clouds.
overlay.exampletoast.spirit.line2: The Tower of Sighs team stands with you—looking far, yet close at hand.
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.title: New Year's Blessing · Tower of Sighs
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.line1: The Tower of Sighs team wishes you a peaceful, prosperous new year.
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.line2: May your journeys in both blocky and real worlds be bright and fulfilled.
